data.title: Pond Duck Adventures

challenges.instruction: Let's build an addition equation for the ducks joining the pond!
challenges.storyText: 2 ducks are swimming in the pond. 1 more duck joins them.

challenges.instruction: Build the equation to show how many ducks are left swimming.
challenges.storyText: 4 ducks are swimming in the pond. 2 ducks waddle away.

challenges.instruction: Put together the addition equation for the new ducks arriving.
challenges.storyText: 1 duck is resting on a lily pad. 3 more ducks swim over to join it.

challenges.instruction: Build the subtraction equation when ducks leave the pond.
challenges.storyText: 5 ducks are paddling in the pond. 3 ducks fly away.

challenges.instruction: Let's build the equation for these swimming ducks!
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are looking for food. 2 more ducks join them.

challenges.instruction: Show the subtraction equation as ducks exit the water.
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are splashing. 1 duck gets out of the pond.

challenges.instruction: Build the final addition equation for our duck family.
challenges.storyText: 2 ducks are resting near the reeds. 2 more ducks join them.

data.description: Young learners explore addition and subtraction concepts using cute pond ducks, building foundational number sentences from visual stories.
